evidence.title: Rajasthan government increases 'PM Kisan Samman Nidhi' amount by Rs 2,000

analysis:
In June 2024 the Rajasthan Chief Minister announced an additional ₹2,000 per year for farmers on top of the central PM-KISAN amount, taking the total to ₹8,000.

By November 2025, the Chief Minister said the state was providing ₹3,000 per year under the Chief Minister Kisan Samman Nidhi, so that farmers were receiving ₹9,000 annually, with a plan to raise this to ₹12,000.

The measure is a state top-up to the central scheme, funded from the state budget.
notes: The announcement overlapped with the state budget presentation in February 2024 and was reiterated by the Chief Minister in June 2024. The 2025 report confirms the top-up was being paid and had been increased above the promised ₹2,000.
